CustomField.description: One line per attachment dropped during classification (filename | mime | bytes | reason), plus one line per ContentDocumentLink insert refusal recorded after the fact. Blank when nothing was dropped and no link was refused — do not read a blank value as "no attachments were sent".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by the attachment capture pipeline. Read this before assuming a broker sent no attachment.
CustomField.label: Dropped Attachment Notes
